fields.name: ebayDomain
fields.description: eBay site domain, default ebay.com. Options: ebay.com (United States), ebay.co.uk (United Kingdom), ebay.de (Germany), ebay.fr (France), ebay.it (Italy), ebay.es (Spain), ebay.ca (Canada), ebay.com.au (Australia), ebay.nl (Netherlands), ebay.at (Austria), ebay.ch (Switzerland), ebay.pl (Poland), ebay.ie (Ireland), ebay.com.hk (Hong Kong, China), ebay.com.my (Malaysia), ebay.com.sg (Singapore)

fields.name: pageSize
fields.description: Maximum results per page, default 50. Options: 25, 50, 100, 200

fields.name: orderBy
fields.description: Sort order, default 12 (Best Match). Options: 1 (Ending soonest), 2 (Price lowest), 3 (Price highest), 7 (Distance nearest), 10 (Newly listed), 12 (Best Match), 15 (Price + shipping lowest), 16 (Price + shipping highest), 18 (New first), 19 (Used first)

fields.name: itemCondition
fields.description: Item condition code, multiple separated by \

fields.name: buyingFormat
fields.description: Buying format. Options: Auction, BIN (Buy It Now), BO (Best Offer)

fields.name: showOnly
fields.description: Filter conditions, comma-separated for multiple values. Options: Complete (Ended), Sold (Sold), FR (Free returns), RPA (Returns accepted), AS (Authorized seller), Savings (Discounts), SaleItems (Sale items), Lots (Lots), Charity (Charity), AV, FS (Free shipping), LPickup (Local pickup)

fields.name: location
fields.description: Country/region code of item location (e.g., 1=United States, 2=Canada, 3=United Kingdom, 45=China, 77=Germany)

fields.name: zipCode
fields.description: ZIP or postal code for filtering shippable items by region

fields.name: categoryId
fields.description: eBay category ID for category-specific search

fields.name: noCache
fields.description: Whether to bypass cache, default false
